value.description: The saved value. Outside changes replace the text while not editing.

onSave.description: Persists the value. Return a promise to show saving; reject it to roll back with a retry.

validate.description: Returns an error message to block saving.

placeholder.description: Shown when the value is empty.

multiline.description: Wraps and grows in height; Shift+Enter adds a line break.

variant.description: Type style: title for names and headings, body for descriptions.

as.description: Element that holds the text, so a title can stay a heading.
